traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), families 315 Campanulaceae, 316 Lobeliaceae, 317 Goodeniaceae and Compositae, the bulk of APG's Asterales: stipules absent; the calyx on an inferior ovary. Menyanthaceae, in the order too (family 294), have a superior one.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Asterales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): leaves spiral. 'sometimes decussate' is our weighting for the many opposite-leaved Asteraceae (Heliantheae, Eupatorieae) and a few Campanulaceae.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Asterales page (read 2026-10-16): leaves spiral at order level; opposite leaves occur mainly in Asteraceae. Every family with candidates states its own value; this fills Phellinaceae (alternate).

traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Asterales page (read 2026-10-16) does not state division at order level; families are overwhelmingly simple-leaved (incl. Asteraceae's own value). Fills Phellinaceae (simple).

traits.rosette.note: APweb, Asterales page (read 2026-10-16): Campanulaceae include rosette and pachycaul forms; most Asteraceae and Campanulaceae are leafy-stemmed. 'usually none' is our weighting by species.

traits.life_span.note: APweb, Asterales page (read 2026-10-16): families range from annual and perennial herbs to woody plants (Rousseaceae, Argophyllaceae, Alseuosmiaceae, Phellinaceae woody; Pentaphragmataceae perennial herbs). DELTA Goodeniaceae: annual or perennial. 'usually perennial' is our weighting by species.

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb, Asterales page (read 2026-10-16): Lobelioideae inflorescences terminal (sometimes axillary); Asteraceae capitula and Campanuloideae cymes mostly end shoots. DELTA Goodeniaceae: clusters terminal or axillary. Weighting is ours.

traits.sexual_system.note: APweb, Asterales page (read 2026-10-16) gives no order statement; nearly all families state hermaphrodite as usual. Fills Phellinaceae only, which needs an override (see family_overrides).
